mapper.select: SELECT bb.id,bb.channel_id,bb.vendor_id,bb.channel_name,ss.vendor_name,ss.id as vendor_primary_id FROM b_marketing_sms_base_info_normal bb inner join b_marketing_sms_vendor_info_normal ss on bb.vendor_id = ss.vendor_id WHRE bb.ope_status in (0,2) and bb.is_delete = 0 and ss.ope_status in (0,2) and ss.is_delete = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE b_marketing_line_base_info_normal SET vendor_id = #{vendorId},channel_name = #{channelName},ope_status = #{opeStatus},ope_time = now() WHERE id = #{id}
